text_simplified: One of the greatest pillars of tarbiyah is for parents to be righteous role models for their children in their words, deeds, and akhlaq, because children are influenced far more by what they see their parents do than by words alone. The early scholars (may Allah have mercy on them) said: "Whoever admonishes his child by his action is more effective than one who admonishes him by his speech."
